title: Bag of Tricks creature selection: bag color as a variant + engine-rolled d8 bound to the use (olc5.14 pattern)
description:
From the PR #690 review (2026-10-26; user chose to hold Bag readiness). Source: 'it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling a d8 and consulting the table that corresponds to the bag's color' (gray/rust/tan tables). Today the binder admits any creature from any of the three tables: the bag's color is not on the record or the instance, and the d8 is not bound to the use. creatureGrantLifecycleOwned therefore keeps the Bag's m4 pending (it requires that a grant name exactly one creature), so pull-fuzzy-object is not ready.
DETERMINISTIC: the bag color is a persistent per-instance property (a variant, the olc5.14 Horn decision); use_item rolls d8 with the engine and stores the resulting table row on the use's bind credit; start_effect admits only that row's creature (required source.bindCreditId, as for countRoll).
DM: placement, the bonus-action commands (adjudicated control), and the creature's behaviour.
EVIDENCE: a real-pack, no-waiver bind of the rolled creature, refusing another row's creature, another color's creature and an unrelated credit; ownership re-derivation updated.
NOT REQUIRED: a generic table-selection engine.
notes: PR #691 merged as a2846bd8 at reviewed head cc1dcd93 (Sol eshyra-olc5.16.2: no material findings).
